value.definition: the runner holding an agent change to the arguments that change takes

invariants.statement: An address written in code is held to the arguments the map states.
An address worked out while a command runs is held to the change's refusals.
The change is loaded and run by the module both runners reach.
A change to a generated file's content is refused whatever guards the change names.
No change is imported here.
Nothing here is proven by a test.

value.definition: the changes a program names run in order and landed as one commit

invariants.statement: A program names the changes that program wants run rather than composing the edits itself.
A change is named by the address that change is filed under.
The arguments a change is handed are the arguments the map beside this binds.
No agent change is named here.
The changes named are run in the order the caller named those changes.
Each change reads the world as every change before that change had already landed.
The edits every change answered land together as a single commit.
The guards the changes named reach run once over the answer the fold gathered.
The world a guard judges is read before the first change in the fold runs.
A change that refuses stops the fold.
A refusal anywhere in the fold lands nothing.
A landing another landing's hold refused answers a refusal rather than throwing.
A call naming no change lands nothing and says so.
A call naming no change is refused as a fault of the call.
A change that refused the fold is refused as a fault of the data.
Changes that all state no edit land nothing and commit nothing.
Naming no change and naming changes that write nothing are two answers.
A mechanical change runs no check.
A body that is not text refuses the landing rather than being decoded.
An agent id is carried only where the caller has an agent id.
The writer a caller names is the commit's author rather than the default author.
A body that moved after the read a caller states refuses the landing.
A caller naming neither reads the tree as the commit at HEAD leaves the tree.
No page is named here.
Nothing here writes the tree.
A caller wanting what landed named in its own refusal hands in the list the landing threads.
A caller wanting the commit itself hands in the slot the landing writes it into.

value.definition: the runner a test reaches a change through rather than importing that change

invariants.statement: A test reaches a change by the address that change is filed under.
The change is loaded off the world the repository itself is read as.
The change is run over the world the test handed in.
A test wanting the addresses reached rather than the edits names a world listing them.
No change is imported here.
